architecture.title: SAP BTP Vibe Coding Workshop Prerequisites — Enterprise Blueprint
architecture.subtitle: Modular 3-Tier decoupled cloud topology compliant with SAP Clean Core mandate.

tiers.name: Tier 1: Experience & UI Layer
tiers.text: Responsive SAP Fiori Horizon UI, React 19 micro-frontends, role-based Launchpad, and mobile offline capabilities.

tiers.name: Tier 2: SAP BTP Cloud Foundry & AI Core
tiers.text: Node.js CAP runtime, asynchronous Event Mesh pub/sub queuing, SAP Generative AI Hub, and automated tenant isolation.

tiers.name: Tier 3: SAP S/4HANA Clean Core System of Record
tiers.text: Released CDS Views, standard OData v4 APIs, and touchless transaction settlement without modifying ERP standard tables.
